- 2026-10-12 · audio · Pronunciation convention (traditional Ethiopian liturgical, or reconstructed Geʿez) and the voice are not chosen. Decided meanwhile: parts publish without audio; the source line keeps the transliteration convention only.
- 2026-10-16 · ch2-8 · Ch. 8 reads ፷ ነፍስ 'sixty souls' where Genesis 7 has eight; HaCohen's text (not checked against Bezold's print) may be wrong or the manuscript variant. Decided meanwhile: kept the source reading, flagged in the unit note. Please check Bezold p. for ch. 8. Also unsolved: ዘይቈርር እምነ አስሐቲያ (rendered tentatively).
